why: This file held the numbers that were printed on /feeds/crawler: a panel of 39,857 sites, 83 sites changed, 519 crawler-level changes. They were typed in by hand and none of the three reproduces from the store under any window. The panel has been 100,000 sites a day since the first read on 9 Jun 2026, and no eight-day window in the archive produces 83 or 519. The file already admitted that a fourth number, 5,324, did not reproduce.
replaced_by: scripts/slice_crawler.py::family_spec(), which builds the page off the same live read as the child pages under it, in the same run. Nothing about this family is typed twice any more.
do_not_restore: Putting counts back in this file puts the same fault back on the page. If a number belongs on /feeds/crawler it has to come out of a query at build time.
